records.footnote: Food & Beverage services refer to the sales of prepared food and drinks for consumption on-premises or take-away. All eating places are included except individual stalls in food courts, hawker centres, coffee shops and canteens. Link to latest RSI/FSI release is available via www.singstat.gov.sg/find-data/explore-data-themes/industry/services/latest-news-data. Relevant methodology paper is available via www.singstat.gov.sg/find-data/explore-data-themes/industry/services/related-information.
